$comment: Share images and social posts. Sizes started from the agd-playground Mireye tool's (src/components/mireye-og/draw.ts OG, banner, social and post sizes, at 4536d86) plus the shared social set. Grounds are the tool's themes (brand.ts THEMES) with every color taken from brand/tokens.css; where the tool and the tokens disagree the tokens win and the note says so. Poster templates are the tool's own layouts (draw.ts layoutFor), redrawn as vectors by src/image/poster.ts; sheet templates are this repo's earlier cut-frame sheets. Sample copy is the tool's occasions (content.ts), shown only with --sample; every word is meant to be replaced.
source: agd-playground src/components/mireye-og at 4536d86 (layouts.ts, draw.ts, brand.ts, content.ts, iso.ts, contours.ts, app.ts)

sizes.$comment: The sizes every brand shares, with each platform's covered and cropped areas, are in src/design/platforms.ts. These are the further sizes this CLI draws (more platforms, IAB display ads, video-call backgrounds, wallpapers), with zones marked official or approximate, and this brand's older names. They belong in the shared table; until it has them they live here.

avoid.name: the profile bar at the top
the call to action at the bottom

floors.note: CSS pixels at the width a picture is usually shown at. Type is never set under them. A working floor: the brand gives none for pictures.

logoRules.note: The brand defines no clear space or minimum size (ASSUMPTIONS 14). Until it does: clear space is the mark's own height all round, and the mark is never under 8 CSS pixels tall at the width the picture is shown.

bone.label: Bone
bone.note: The tool's bone is #f3f0eb and its ink #000000; the tokens' Bone #F4F1EA and Forest ink #1E231C win. Grid alpha 0.22 is the tool's.

green.label: Green
green.note: The tool's green is #262b26 (also the illustration skill's ground); the tokens' Forest #1E231C wins. The tool's sage #b3bbad muted becomes the inverse muted token #C9CDC8.

brown.label: Brown
brown.note: Earth #2A2119 matches the tool's brown. Its muted #c9bfb2 has no token; Sand #D9CDB8 is the nearest warm token.

black.label: Black
black.note: The tool's black ground is #060606; the token black #000000 wins. The tool's white theme is left out: the illustration skill says finished designs never use pure white.

art.note: The tool draws mireye.com's land drawings as tinted PNGs (art/residential.png, art/mcp.png). They are the illustration skill's residential and apicore scenes, so images draw those scenes as vectors instead.

photo.note: The tool darkens an aerial with rgba(14,12,9,0.56) over a stock photo (photos/farm.jpg). Stock photos are not shipped: pass --image. The shade is the black token at 0.58, the least that keeps bone words at 4.5:1 over a white picture (the tool's 0.56 gives 4.4:1).

app.note: The Ask panel (app.ts) uses #000000, #f3f0eb, #b3bbad, #3a3a36 and #262b26; each maps to the nearest token (the line to Track dark #5E645E, the darkest gray the product uses on a dark fill).

type.note: The tool sets every word in Gilroy (headline 400, -14/1000 em, 1.04 leading; line under it 400 at 1.42), Geist for interface text and Geist Mono for data. The repo ships Gilroy 400 and 500 and DM Mono, so Geist becomes Gilroy, Geist Mono becomes DM Mono, the chart numbers (Gilroy Light 300) are Regular and the partner name (600) is Medium, the heaviest weight the brand uses.

lockup.note: The tool's lockup is the logomark beside mireye.com's lowercase wordmark. This repo's approved lockup (ASSUMPTIONS 7: the wordmark is not final) is the logomark with the name set in Gilroy, so images use that in the same box.
